description: This file defines the EmpWorkExperience entity class for the OrangeHRM project, representing employee work experience data with ORM mappings and accessors.

classes.name: EmpWorkExperience
classes.description: Entity class representing an employee's work experience, mapped to 'hs_hr_emp_work_experience' table with properties for employer, job title, dates, comments, and associated employee.

methods.name: getSeqNo
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the work experience record.

methods.name: setSeqNo
methods.description: Sets the sequence number of the work experience record.

methods.name: getEmployer
methods.description: Returns the employer name associated with the experience.

methods.name: setEmployer
methods.description: Sets the employer name for this work experience.

methods.name: getJobTitle
methods.description: Returns the job title held in this experience.

methods.name: setJobTitle
methods.description: Sets the job title for this work experience.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the starting date of employment.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the starting date of employment.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the ending date of employment.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the ending date of employment.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Returns comments related to the work experience.

methods.name: setComments
methods.description: Sets comments related to the work experience.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee object associated with this experience.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with this work experience.

calls: ORM annotations in class and properties for ORM mapping
